title: Юный Сарутоби Сасукэ
alt: Magic Boy Magic Boy 少年猿飛佐助
description: "Magic Boy" was the first ever Japanese animation to be released theatrically in North America. Sasuke, a boy vexed by an evil witch, studies magic and uses his powers to defeat her. (Source: bcdb)

en:
"Magic Boy" was the first ever Japanese animation to be released theatrically in North America. 


Sasuke, a boy vexed by an evil witch, studies magic and uses his powers to defeat her. 


(Source: bcdb)
